text.title: sql-optimization Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable signals — preconditions, captured plan, estimate skew, scan type, pagination shape, write mix — to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml.

decision-tree.root-question: Preconditions: Postgres-class DB, a slow query identified in APM or pg_stat_statements, and a staging snapshot at production volume?

conclusion.verdict: missing preconditions; profile the application side, or route to a store-appropriate methodology
STOP — capture EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) first; everything below reads that plan

branch.question: Do actual rows differ from estimated by more than 10x anywhere in the plan?

conclusion.verdict: ANALYZE the table and re-capture before proposing an index; no index fixes a wrong estimate

branch.question: What does the plan and the query shape actually show?

conclusion.verdict: switch to keyset pagination on (last_seen_at, id); an index will not rescue OFFSET at depth
rewrite as JOIN + aggregation; confirm a single execution in the new plan
add a composite index with equality columns first, range column last
consider a partial or covering index; if neither fits, the answer is a materialized view or caching, not an index
precompute into a materialized view refreshed CONCURRENTLY
audit existing indexes against pg_stat_user_indexes and drop the unused ones
rewrite the query: explicit columns, filter early, no Cartesian product

text.example: preconditions=true, explain captured, estimate 10k vs actual 1.5M q-skew -> true => investigate-row-estimate-skew: ANALYZE orders, re-capture. second pass: skew resolved, seqscan on (tenant_id, created_at), columns indexable => composite-index-ordering: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ix_orders_tenant_created_id ON orders (tenant_id, created_at DESC, id). Merge only with before/after plans and a sample size (regression-gate-before-merge).
